datasets.name: Students Performance in Exams
datasets.description: Standardized benchmark dataset examining student performance across math, reading, and writing cognitive dimensions with demographic, test preparation, and study attributes.
datasets.target: Overall Score & Performance Category (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert)
datasets.roleInPipeline: Trained Ridge Regression coefficients for domain weight mapping and continuous score regression.

datasets.name: Higher Education Students Performance Evaluation
datasets.description: Comprehensive university student benchmark evaluating academic performance against weekly study hours, seminar attendance, assignment submissions, project contribution, and discussion engagement.
datasets.target: Academic Grade Level (0-7 mapped to 4-tier Proficiency Hierarchy)
datasets.roleInPipeline: Trained CART Decision Tree for discrete student level prediction and learning streak correlation.

datasets.name: Student Cognitive Skill & Logic Assessment Dataset
datasets.description: Multi-domain assessment benchmark tracking candidate performance across 5 specific cognitive pillars: Analytical Reasoning, Problem Solving, Decision Making, Attention & Consistency, and Knowledge Recall.
datasets.target: Skill Gap Classification & Domain Mastery Verification
datasets.roleInPipeline: Trained Multi-Class Logistic Softmax and k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN, k=5) for adaptive assignment recommendation and confidence calibration.

algorithms.name: Multi-variable Ridge & Linear Regression
algorithms.formula: y_hat = w^T x + b, where w = (X^T X + lambda I)^-1 X^T y
algorithms.purpose: Calculates continuous overall score (0-100) from normalized domain sub-scores and question difficulty weights.

algorithms.name: CART Decision Tree Classifier
algorithms.formula: Gini(D) = 1 - sum(p_i^2), split on argmin Gini_split(D, A)
algorithms.purpose: Constructs hierarchical decision boundaries to classify candidates into Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Expert levels, and classifies domain-specific skill gaps.

algorithms.name: Multi-Class Softmax / Logistic Classifier
algorithms.formula: P(y = k | x) = exp(w_k^T x + b_k) / sum_j exp(w_j^T x + b_j)
algorithms.purpose: Generates calibrated probabilistic confidence intervals for candidate qualification and verified recruiter benchmarks.

algorithms.name: k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) Recommender
algorithms.purpose: Matches candidate's domain feature vector against Kaggle student cohorts to recommend personalized assignment tracks and study buddy peers.

modelMetadata.framework: Custom Pure-JS ML Pipeline (No Third-Party AI API)
